data.research_question: Which named people create the highest-value cross-connections around the Trump Foundation branch?
data.method: Roster expansion, public biography review, and deterministic set-intersection ranking.
classification_rules: Rank independently sourced institutional memberships, not allegations.
Keep direct, inferred, and unresolved relations separate.
Do not infer control from board, advisory, family, career, military, or philanthropic overlap.

findings.finding: Shlomo Dovrat ranked first with six institutional sets and fifteen pairwise intersections.
Eli Hurvitz and Yossi Baidatz each ranked with five sets and ten pairwise intersections.
The possible Hurvitz-to-Dan-Meridor employment edge remains unresolved.
